# Nara Charm

Nara Charm is a heritage-inspired jewelry studio. Its collections explore wire curves, cord knots, stone colors and textile folds. Product pages list details specific to the piece, including available materials and care notes. Images marked as design illustrations present an interpretation of the piece. The studio section features designs in progress.

## Ordering

For the current price and stock, open the individual product page. For questions about a piece, an order, or a studio design, use the [contact page](https://naracharm.com/contact). See the [shipping policy](https://naracharm.com/shipping) for current rates and the [return policy](https://naracharm.com/returns) for conditions. The [sitemap](https://naracharm.com/sitemap.xml) lists the public pages included in the release.
